literal: With the proud right saying 'He gave (it)', this pallor, having presented itself, spreads upon my body.
translation: With the proud claim that 'He gave me to her,' this pallor has presented itself and spreads all over my body.
modern: அவர் (என் காதலர்) தான் என்னைத் தந்தார் என்ற உரிமையோடு, இந்தப் பசப்பு என் உடம்பின் மேல் வந்து பரவுகிறது.
explanation: The heroine is suffering from the pain of separation, which manifests as a sickly yellow-green pallor on her skin. She personifies this pallor as an uninvited guest who behaves with absolute authority. The pallor spreads boldly across her body, acting as if it has a legitimate right to be there because it was given to her as a parting gift by her lover himself. By using the words 'avar' (he) and 'ivar' (this person), she highlights the intimate connection between her lover's departure and the arrival of her physical grief.
